svg.title: Frontend: App.tsx keeps the token and the active tab; pages and components call api.ts, the only file that talks to the backend
svg.text: No router: App.tsx keeps two pieces of state. Every HTTP call goes through api.ts, so pages never deal with fetch, headers or tokens.
